title: CSS grid gap collapses with negative margins
content: Negative margins on grid children interact with gap unexpectedly; prefer padding on the track.

title: Bumped webpack splitChunks minSize to 30kb
content: Tuning cacheGroups.minSize reduced the vendor chunk count on the marketing site.

title: Timezone off-by-one in date picker
content: Parsing ISO dates without an explicit zone shifted the displayed day in UTC-negative locales; pin to UTC.

title: Chose Redis over in-memory cache for session store
content: Multi-instance deploy needed shared sessions; Redis TTL semantics fit the logout flow.
